## 3. Crop Protection Category Catalog

### 3.1 Insecticides
* **Purpose**: Systemic and contact insecticides formulated to eliminate chewing, sucking, and boring pests at various crop growth stages.
* **Focus Areas**: Whiteflies, aphids, thrips, stem borers, termites, and soil insects.
* **Category Link**: [https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=insecticides](https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=insecticides)

### 3.2 Herbicides
* **Purpose**: Broad-spectrum selective and non-selective weed control solutions to optimize soil nutrition for the primary crop.
* **Focus Areas**: Annual and perennial grass control, broadleaf weeds in bunds, orchards, and non-cropped land.
* **Category Link**: [https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=herbicides](https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=herbicides)

### 3.3 Fungicides
* **Purpose**: Multi-site contact and systemic disease control formulas to stop blight, rust, downy mildew, powdery mildew, and rot.
* **Focus Areas**: Preventive nursery sprays and curative field interventions.
* **Category Link**: [https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=fungicides](https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=fungicides)

### 3.4 Bio Pesticides
* **Purpose**: Botanical extracts and organic pest repellents for low-residue crop management and ecological farming.
* **Focus Areas**: Natural repellent barriers, eco-friendly spraying programs, and Integrated Pest Management (IPM).
* **Category Link**: [https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=bio-pesticides](https://vanikicrop.com/products?category=bio-pesticides)

## 4. Product Catalog Sheet & Application Rates

### 4.1 Imidacloprid 17.8% SL Insecticide
* **Formulation**: Soluble Liquid (SL) concentrate.
* **Active Ingredient**: Imidacloprid (17.8% concentration).
* **Product Link**: [https://vanikicrop.com/product/imidacloprid-17-8-sl-insecticide](https://vanikicrop.com/product/imidacloprid-17-8-sl-insecticide)
* **Application Mode**: Systemic with translaminar movement (absorbed through leaves and roots to protect the entire plant structure).
* **Target Pests**: Sucking pests including Aphids, Jassids, Thrips, and Whiteflies.
* **Primary Crops**: Cotton, Paddy, Chilli, Sugarcane, and Pulse crops.
* **Package Variants & Pricing**:
  * **100 ml Pack**: ₹430 (MRP ₹490) | SKU: `IMIDA-100ML`
  * **250 ml Pack**: ₹980 (MRP ₹1120) | SKU: `IMIDA-250ML`

* **Product Link**: [https://vanikicrop.com/product/chlorpyrifos-20-ec](https://vanikicrop.com/product/chlorpyrifos-20-ec)

* **Target Pests**: Termites, Stem Borers, Root Grubs, and major soil-borne insects.
* **Primary Crops**: Paddy, Wheat, Cotton, Sugarcane, and Citrus orchards.

* **Application Mode**: Non-selective systemic herbicide. Translocates from leaf contact down into the root system to completely dry out weeds.

## 5. Agronomy Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

#### Q: How can I identify the best dosage for Imidacloprid on my paddy crop?
* **A**: Use 100-125 ml of Imidacloprid 17.8% SL per acre mixed in 200 liters of water during early vegetative stages when pest counts exceed economic thresholds (e.g. 5-10 planthoppers per hill).

#### Q: Can Mancozeb be mixed with systemic insecticides?
* **A**: Yes, Mancozeb 75% WP is highly compatible with systemic insecticides like Imidacloprid. This combination provides a complete dual shield against sucking pests and early blight. Always perform a jar-test first to check physical compatibility.

#### Q: Is Glyphosate safe to spray directly over growing vegetables?
* **A**: **No.** Glyphosate 41% SL is a non-selective herbicide, meaning it will dry out any green crop it touches. Use it carefully along bunds, non-cropped margins, or pre-planting with a protective nozzle hood to avoid drift onto your primary crops.

#### Q: What are the benefits of Azadirachtin (Neem Oil) 3000 PPM in IPM?
* **A**: Neem Oil acts as an anti-feedant, growth regulator, and egg suppressor. Because it works through ingestion and direct contact without harmful chemical residues, it allows beneficial predatory insects (like ladybugs) to survive, maintaining ecological balance.
